scope: Only saved source-val predictions and training histories/configurations, no inference/training/test/Real/raw logs
warning: Same original normal window identities and unchanged normal labels, but inputs, statistics, training labels, qualification/exclusions, suffix population and training budget changed. Not a controlled single-factor causal experiment. Old faulty-label aggregate scores are historical only.

training.device: cuda:0, mandatory for formal mode; never silently fall back to CPU
training.initialization: Fresh random CPU initialization from each registered seed. Paired arms have identical initial state digest; no pretrained source or target checkpoint loaded.
training.normalization: Fixed source norm_stats.json per batch, no Real fitting

validation.dataset: Entire source val.pt, all 35520 windows each epoch, no cap beyond existing cache
validation.checkpoint_selection: Strict maximum overall source validation Macro-F1; earliest epoch wins exact ties. Save every strict improvement, including <0.002.

early_stop.rule: Separate significant-improvement reference. Count non-improving epochs only from min_epochs; strict score>reference+delta resets counter. Stop at patience or max_epochs.

required_reports: original normal by flight status (including hover)
validation.interpretation: Keep identical selection in both arms to isolate sampling; stratified validation is mandatory and cannot be replaced by overall F1. This is source development evidence, not blind final testing or a release gate.

training.schedule: Existing get_warmup_cosine_lr zero-based epoch, fixed30 epoch horizon
training.initialization: Fresh CPU seeded initialization, paired arms identical digest, no old weights
training.formal_device: cuda:0 required, never silently fall back or allocate GPU

validation.population: All34710 current qualified source val, never sampled/reweighted for formal run
validation.prediction_rule: argmax binary logits, fixed fault threshold0.5, no threshold sweep
validation.checkpoint: Strict maximum overall source val Macro-F1; earliest exact tie wins; save any strict improvement

early_stop.rule: Reuse selection_step separate significant_reference; strict improvements always checkpoint, patience counts only from min_epochs

validation.interpretation: Source-development only; one seed is not statistical proof; report both arms without discarding lower arm
